name: Tormus Deepforge
summary: Tormus Deepforge is a dwarven smith working at the center of the Great Forge in Ironforge. A dependable craftsman, he coordinates iron deliveries and supplies armaments for Alliance defense efforts across Khaz Modan and beyond.

sections.title: Master of the Great Forge
sections.body: Positioned right beside the roaring fires of the Great Forge, Tormus Deepforge oversees substantial metalworking tasks on behalf of the Bronzebeard clan. Beyond hammering steel himself, Tormus mourns his mentor, Sturgy Ironband, whose smithing compound south of Helm's Bed Lake in eastern Dun Morogh was overrun by Dark Iron dwarves after a load of strange umbral ore arrived there.

faq.q: Where can I find Tormus Deepforge?
faq.answer: Tormus stands on the circular walkway encircling the lava pool of the Great Forge, the central hub of Ironforge.

faq.q: What role does Tormus play in the Alliance war effort?
faq.answer: Tormus forges weapons for young warriors sent to him at the Great Forge. In return he asks them to avenge his mentor, Sturgy Ironband, by entering Ironband's Compound in Dun Morogh and recovering the umbral ore the Dark Iron dwarves killed for, which he then works into new grey iron weapons.
Several dwarves share the Deepforge name, including Bengus, Murgot, and Kaita Deepforge, as well as Tormus's colleague Thorvald in Loch Modan, but whether they are related has never been confirmed.

angles.text: For smiths plying their trade at the Great Forge, Tormus represents the essential link between raw bar stock and frontline military outfitting.
A proud artisan of the mountain kingdom, Tormus demonstrates Ironforge's readiness to smelt and deliver arms whenever allies in the Grand Alliance call for aid.
